title: Contents Packout & Storage Electronics Coverage Schedule
content:
Under Contents Packout & Storage declared-value coverage on Partial Contents Packout and Full Contents Packout jobs, electronics are covered on their own schedule: **when the electronics item quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the electronics rated threshold, the electronics coverage is the declared value times the electronics value rider percentage, divided by one hundred, never less than the per-item electronics rider times one item fewer than the electronics rated threshold; when they total at least one item but fewer than the electronics rated threshold, the electronics coverage is the number of electronics items times the per-item electronics rider; a job with no electronics item on its packout lines carries no electronics coverage.**

## Schedule

| Electronics items on the job's packout lines | Basis | Electronics coverage per period |
|---|---|---|
| 8 or more (at least the electronics rated threshold) | rated on value | the declared value times 0.06, divided by one hundred, but never less than 1.75 times 7 (one item fewer than the threshold), that is never less than 12.25 |
| 1 to 7 | scheduled per item | the number of electronics items times 1.75 |
| none | — | no electronics coverage |

The items counted are the quantities on the electronics packing lines booked on the job. The declared value is the value recorded on the job at signing.

## Cases (hypothetical declared values)

| Electronics items | Declared value | Electronics coverage |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | any | 5 times 1.75, 8.75 |
| 7 | any | 7 times 1.75, 12.25 |
| 8 | 30,000.00 | 30,000.00 times 0.06 divided by one hundred is 18.00; not below 12.25, so 18.00 |
| 8 | 10,000.00 | 6.00 by value, below 12.25, so 12.25 |
| 0 | any | none |
